Zero standing privilege with zero access friction
NO VAULTS, STATIC CREDENTIALS, BASTIONS OR MANUAL WORKFLOWS
P0’s Authorization Control Plane powers ZSP for every user, NHI, and agent. With centralized visibility, just enough privilege and just-in-time controls, P0 customers enjoy end-to-end production access security that keeps pace with development.
Learn about the P0 Platform
Dynamic access management
Enforce short-lived, least privileged access natively in every system, eliminating standing access and static credentials.
Explore access management
Continuous privilege governance
Tie all user, NHI and agentic access back to the IdP for end-to-end privilege visibility, informed policy design and continuous audit readiness.
Explore privilege governance
Complete production coverage
Centralize access control across cloud and on-prem, including cloud entitlements, virtual machines, databases, RDP sessions and more.
Explore full-stack integrations
Let’s change the way you manage privilege.
Extend PAM to multi-cloud and hybrid environments with a central access control plane for all users, NHIs and agents.

If “governing privileged access” still means vaulting static credentials and shared jump-host accounts, you’re solving yesterday’s problem with yesterday’s tools.

OAuth scopes don’t equal secure MCP authorization
OAuth scopes solve an important part of the authorization puzzle: delegated capability. But they are only one piece. To do MCP authorization properly, you need scopes for the big picture and server-side RBAC for least-privilege enforcement.
